verdicts.explanation: The Li3PS4 polymorphs section states that γ-Li3PS4 has a very low Li conductivity of 3(10−4) mS/cm and cites ref. 11, so the value is literature_cited. No measurement temperature is given, so null is correct.

The Discussion says β-Li3PS4's bulk ionic conductivity has been reported as 8.9 10−3 mS/cm, and the sentence ends with citation 15. The bulk kind, mS/cm unit and cited origin are correct, and no temperature is stated.

The Discussion gives 0.16 mS/cm for the nanoporous form of β-Li3PS4, cited to ref. 15. The synthesis note matches the paper's statement that β-Li3PS4 was stabilized as nanoporous particles from solution-state synthesis (refs. 15, 16).

The Discussion gives room-temperature Li conductivity of ∼2 mS/cm for the α polymorph, cited to ref. 18, so the origin is literature_cited. The paper states room temperature, and the synthesis note matches the paper's description of the rapid heating and quenching technique with ref. 18. A null numeric Celsius value is conservative, not a wrong claim.
